mapper.sql: select su.user_id, su.username, su.password, su.nickname, su.avatar, su.role_id, sr.role_name, su.sex, su.age, su.phone, su.status, su.del_flag, su.create_time, su.update_time, su.remark from sys_user su left join sys_role sr on su.role_id = sr.role_id
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (username, password, nickname, avatar, role_id, sex, age, phone, status, remark) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{roleId}, #{sex}, #{age}, #{phone}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update sys_user set del_flag = '2' where user_id = #{userId}
